paper_title: Search for an axion-like particle in radiative $J/ψ$ decays
notes: BESIII search for ALP in J/psi radiative decays, a->gamma gamma, mass range 0.165-2.84 GeV. Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton (g_agamma). Only an approximate single data point is extractable from text: g_agamma > 3e-4 GeV^-1 excluded near m_a ~ 0.25 GeV (=2.5e8 eV). The full exclusion curve is in Fig. 6 but numerical values are not tabulated. Most stringent limit for 0.165-1.468 GeV. Collider bound, not DM haloscope, so no DM density.
